items.title: Return completed Schadenfragebogen with Wildschadenbescheinigung
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: Letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026. This is a private deadline counted from the stated start (the letter's date); per §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026 (Sunday). 'Werktage' is explicitly defined in the letter as Monday–Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting Werktage from 23.11.: Mo23.11=1, Tu24.11=2, We25.11=3, Th26.11=4, Fr27.11=5, Sa28.11=6, (Su29.11 skipped), Mo30.11=7, Tu01.12=8, We02.12=9, Th03.12=10, Fr04.12=11, Sa05.12=12, (Su06.12 skipped), Mo07.12=13th Werktag. The sender's office sits in Wiesbaden, Hessen; no public holiday falls in this window under either Hessen or NRW holiday calendars (Buß- und Bettag already passed on 18.11.2026), so no adjustment is needed. The 13th Werktag (07.12.2026, a Monday) is itself a working day, so it is the due date.
